newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds trapped by congestion around 101.80.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds trapped by congestion around 101.80.

text.p: June Bund futures on LIFFE have been unable to get past weighty congestion around 101.80 in recent days, suggesting the market may be set for a decline on Wednesday, analysts said.

"The problem we've had is there is this substantial area of congestion we have built up now between 101.80 and 101.88 and that's not been willing to give way," Marc Ostwald, technical strategist at London Bond Broking here, said.
"There just hasn't been the buying power behind it for a move up to the 102.14,18 level," Ostwald said.
June Bunds were quoted at 101.76, down 0.01 at 0647 GMT.
Bunds topped out at 101.90 on Tuesday, after hitting a high of 101.82 last Friday and 101.80 last Thursday.
Above there, the contract would target the 102.18 spike high from March 11, Ostwald said.
He added unless the contract pushed through to there early on it would have a bit of a setback.
The first major downside target would be 101.48.
"That's the old 1994 high which is just a huge level," Ostwald said.
If the contract managed to slip through there it would then drift back to 101.14, the high on April 17.
Analysts at Chase in London said trendline resistance intervening at 102.20,26 on daily and weekly charts should limit short term gains for Bunds.

"But once it has developed a daily closing price above 102.26 further gains to 103.20 are likely," they said in a research note. That level is just above the high for the contract at 103.16 on February 28.

At the short end, September Euromarks were quoted at 96.73, down 0.01 at 0713 GMT. Volume in this contract was 1,271 lots and open interest at 208,977 versus volume of 861 and open interest of 231,409 for the June contract.
